questions.explanationEn: Stratified random sampling is frequently used in socio-economic surveys because social stratification is social reality. As in a society of heterogeneous population people are divided in different homogenous groups on the basis of caste & religion. The stratified random sampling devices heterogeneous population in a group of homogenous population, which is called as strata or layer. It is used frequently in socio-economic surveys because of heterogeneous nature of population in society, which makes stratification a social reality.
